purpose: Produce a deterministic composition plan for one DATAPREV Sessões session before pedagogical content generation.

inputs.session_coverage_map: Existing primary/secondary/review relations; never infer mastery from them.
inputs.prerequisite_map: Advisory graph only; it may affect sequencing and support depth but never blocks manual access.
inputs.learner_event_store: Raw evidence including correctness, attempts, confidence, support use, justification, notes and recency.
inputs.source_registry: Only registered and provenance-valid sources may support normative or real-question claims.
inputs.roadmap: Current ordered session plan used for automatic buffer selection only.

manual_prepare: Do not mutate earlier session progress.
Do not create a following session in cascade.
auto_buffer: Only act for a discipline with a session currently in progress.
Select the immediately following ROADMAP session.
If that session is already ready, do nothing.
Never prepare more than one session ahead.
adaptive_composition: Use raw learner evidence to adjust depth, review targets, examples, difficulty and support.
External-channel evidence is context only and never marks Sessões coverage complete.
Do not compute definitive mastery in v2.

invariants: Manual requests target exactly one requested session.
Prerequisites are advisory_only and cannot be navigation blockers.
No output may mark prior sessions complete or alter learner history.
No output may assign mastered or a mastery score.
No source may be cited as official/real unless provenance is verified.
Every referenced coverage_id must exist and be mapped_validated or later.
Publication is outside the Composer and requires staging + QA gate.
